steps.title: Distance is not the cause
steps.say: Surprisingly, Earth is actually closest to the Sun in January! Distance does not cause the seasons.

steps.title: Tilt creates direct sunlight
steps.say: Notice where you dragged Earth: the north leans directly toward the Sun, concentrating the sunlight and creating summer.

steps.title: Opposite seasons
steps.say: At the exact same moment, the southern hemisphere leans away and experiences winter, proving distance cannot be the reason.
